download_snapshot: download all files from a Hugging Face model repo into the local cache directory
download_snapshot_filtered: download only files matching allow_patterns and excluding ignore_patterns from a repo
download_snapshot_dry_run: perform a dry run to list files that would be downloaded without actually downloading them
download_snapshot_local_dir: download repo files and replicate the file structure into a specified local directory
download_snapshot_offline: resolve a cached snapshot from local disk when offline or when the remote repo is unreachable
